job.job_description:
• Experience on Java, Springboot, microservices, backend development. Able to design end-to-end AI-enabled solutions.
• Developer should have working knowledge of how LLMs behave in production systems.Hands-on experience integrating AI/ML services (e.g., LLM APIs) into microservices-based applications. Strong understanding of prompt engineering, AI system design, and building scalable AI-enabled backend services. Exposure to RAG architectures, vector data handling, and AI performance optimization is preferred. Leverage AI tools effectively in development lifecycle.
• Experience in design, development and triaging for large, complex systems. experience in Java and object-oriented design skills.
• Experience in microservices development.experience in Spring Boot.
• Interconnecting microservices with databases
• Knowledge of Vulnerability management & how streaming systems such as Kafka operate
• Familiarity with software development design patterns: GIT, Swagger, PCF, and Rabbit MQ
• Expertise in API technologies such as Rest Webservices
• Previous experience writing unit tests with JUnit, Mockito, or PowerMock
• Knowledge of markup languages such as JSON and YML
• Working knowledge of quality and security scan technologies such as Sonar, Vulnerability management on Blackduck/Fortify, and WebInspect
• Knowledge of the Agile approach
• Work in a fast-paced, project-centered, team-oriented atmosphere
• Visit clients outside of the nation to gather and specify needs
• Create solutions that are high-quality, scalable, and maintainable, with an emphasis on backend systems and related technologies
• Carry out unit and integration tests
• Identifying and resolving bugs
• Make sure you've developed enough test cases to ensure the design criteria are satisfied
• Produce well-written documentation for each microservice
• Communicate with other developers
• Creating and deploying microservices using the Spring Boot framework
• Adherence to the whole Software Development Life Cycle
